West Bengal schools following the Durga Puja calendar may remain closed, while Maharashtra's Diwali vacation is scheduled to begin on November 2. Schools in Uttar Pradesh, Delhi-NCR, Telangana and other states are expected to follow their respective reopening schedules. Parents should check official school notices and district orders for confirmed closures.
 School holiday tomorrow, October 23, 2026: Check state-wise updates for Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, UP, Delhi
 School holiday tomorrow, October 23, 2026: Students and parents across India are checking whether schools will remain closed on Friday amid festive vacations, post-Dussehra reopening schedules and heavy rainfall in parts of southern India. However, October 23 is not a nationwide school holiday, and the status varies by state, district and individual school.
 While schools in West Bengal are expected to continue their Durga Puja vacation, Maharashtra's main Diwali break is scheduled to begin in November. In Tamil Nadu, authorities may announce district-specific closures depending on rainfall and local conditions. Meanwhile, schools in Uttar Pradesh, Delhi-NCR, Bihar, Jharkhand, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana and Karnataka are expected to follow their respective autumn vacation and reopening schedules.
Parents should check official school circulars and district administration announcements before sending children to school, particularly in areas affected by heavy rain.

 These are reported schedules and expected statuses, not a consolidated list of confirmed closures. Individual schools may follow different calendars, and local authorities can issue separate orders.
 Live Events
 Maharashtra school holiday: Diwali vacation begins on November 2
Students in Maharashtra should not assume that October 23 is a Diwali holiday. According to the education department schedule cited in the supplied information, the 2026 Diwali vacation for recognised schools is scheduled from November 2 to November 14.
 Schools are expected to reopen on November 16, marking the start of the second academic term. The schedule applies to recognised primary, secondary and higher secondary schools, subject to applicable education department instructions.
 Therefore, regular classes are expected to continue on October 23 unless a school or local authority announces a separate holiday.
 Tamil Nadu school holiday tomorrow: Will Chennai schools remain closed?
Tamil Nadu is facing a different situation because of heavy rainfall in several districts. Continuous rain, waterlogging and concerns over local flooding have prompted school closures in parts of the state.
On October 22, schools were closed in Thoothukudi, Tirunelveli, Tenkasi and Kanniyakumari following heavy rainfall. Authorities are monitoring weather conditions, and further district-specific closure announcements may be issued if required.
However, there is no blanket school closure across Tamil Nadu in the information provided. Whether schools in Chennai and other districts remain open on October 23 depends on the latest orders issued by the relevant district administrations.
Parents should check official announcements before sending children to school, as rain-related closures can differ between districts.
 West Bengal school holiday: Durga Puja break continues
Many schools in West Bengal are expected to remain closed on October 23 as part of the extended Durga Puja vacation.
The reported holiday schedule for recognised schools runs through October 26, 2026, with Lakshmi Puja also falling during the festive period. Schools following this calendar are expected to remain closed on Friday.
Parents should nevertheless confirm the reopening date with their children's schools, as institutional calendars and holiday arrangements may differ.
 Uttar Pradesh and Noida school holiday update
Students in Uttar Pradesh, including Noida and Ghaziabad, should check whether their schools are following an extended autumn vacation.
Some reported school calendars list a break from October 18 to October 25, with classes expected to resume on October 26. Under this schedule, schools would remain closed on October 23.
However, other calendars provide a shorter Dussehra break around October 19 and 20. Under those schedules, schools may reopen before October 23.
The difference means there is no uniform reopening date established by the supplied information for all schools in Uttar Pradesh. Parents should follow the latest circular issued by their school or the relevant district administration.
 Delhi school holiday update
Several school calendars in Delhi-NCR list a Dussehra break from October 18 to October 20. Under these schedules, schools are generally expected to reopen before Friday, October 23.
However, autumn vacation dates and local holiday arrangements may vary between institutions. Parents should check the latest school notification to confirm whether regular classes will be held.
 Telangana school holiday: Classes expected to resume on October 23
Schools in Telangana are expected to resume classes on Friday, October 23, after the Dasara vacation.
According to the schedule described in the supplied information, the School Education Department announced holidays from October 10 to October 22, with classes proposed to resume on October 23.
Students and parents should confirm the reopening schedule with their respective schools, particularly if examinations or other school-specific arrangements affect the timetable.
 Bihar, Jharkhand, Andhra Pradesh and Karnataka school holiday updates
Schools in Bihar and Jharkhand are generally expected to reopen after their reported festive breaks ended on October 21.
In Andhra Pradesh, the reported Dasara vacation ran from October 12 to October 21, with schools expected to resume regular classes afterwards. Karnataka's reported autumn vacation schedules also indicate that many schools should reopen after around October 21.
These dates may vary depending on the school calendar and local instructions. Students should check with their respective institutions before assuming that October 23 is a holiday.
 What should parents check before sending children to school?
With festive vacations ending at different times across states and weather-related closures possible in Tamil Nadu, parents should:
 Check the latest circular or message issued by the school.
 Look for official district administration announcements regarding rain-related closures.
 Confirm the reopening date after Dussehra or autumn vacation.
 Check for separate examination schedules or school-specific holidays.
 In summary, October 23, 2026, is not a nationwide school holiday. Many schools are expected to reopen after their festive breaks, West Bengal schools following the Durga Puja calendar may remain closed, Maharashtra's Diwali vacation begins on November 2, and Tamil Nadu closures depend on district-level weather orders.
